name: independent-redteam-round-5
description: Blind red-team set written after v0.45.0 rules were frozen.
positive_definition: A sample is counted as flagged when the assigned tool reports at least one finding with severity low, medium, high, or critical. Info-level inventory rules (for example SF12, FL10, PG10, PF12, MF10, MO14) are ignored.
method: Rules were frozen before this set was written. Techniques cited in SOURCES.md were chosen from published research not used as the basis of rounds 1–4. Files marked generated=true are materialized by generate.py (fake provider-shaped secrets that GitHub push protection would block).

samples.notes: CSV / spreadsheet formula injection is a different channel than Markdown images or CSS/SVG used earlier.
